commandOrSteps: For each path: git log -1 --format=%H HEAD -- <path>; git rev-parse <path-commit>:<path>; git cat-file blob <git-blob>; compute SHA-256 from blob bytes; compare with git hash-object --path=<path> --stdin. Preserve every previous catalogue pointer before replacing it.
environment: Windows PowerShell; repository checkout; bundled Node 24.19.0; local Git object database; no backend or staging access.
expected: Reconcile every existing source pointer from its own path-specific committed Git blob, preserve the previous pointer as history, and register newly added source tests/helpers with their measured baseline state.
actual: Individually verified 181 existing source records and registered 10 new source test/helper paths. Each path-specific commit contains the exact current working Git blob; SHA-256 was calculated from actual Git blob bytes. Previous catalogue heads/hashes and the global baseline were preserved. The canonical checker is rerun after this TRACKING self-audit.
notes: Per-file provenance reconciliation only. It does not certify production, backend, staging, UI acceptance or hosted CI.
